label: 인스타그램
prompt_hint: Create an Instagram-ready promotional image optimized for modern Korean social media aesthetics. Use the uploaded product image as the only hero subject while preserving realistic appearance, balanced composition, clean spacing, and refined SNS visual quality. Maintain natural environmental styling without changing the original product identity.
channel_prompt: Use the uploaded product image as the ONLY main subject. Create a Korean Instagram-style promotional image layout. This prompt defines composition rules, image behavior, visual hierarchy, and layout constraints. Maintain a single-product composition and preserve the uploaded product identity, shape, color, texture, and realistic appearance. Do not generate additional products. Build a clean layered composition using subtle environmental depth, soft background separation, and natural scene continuity while keeping the uploaded product visually clear and dominant. Maintain balanced spacing around the full product composition and clear single-product visual hierarchy. If the uploaded product is placed on a coaster, tray, plate, napkin, or supporting surface, preserve the original object relationship and keep the product naturally centered on that support object. Treat the product and its support as a single anchored composition unit. For beverage products, do not modify the internal drink composition, including ice, pearls, toppings, liquid amount, liquid level, ingredient ratio, or visible contents. Allow only subtle controlled visual enhancement such as slightly warmer or cleaner color temperature, mild saturation improvement, and moderate brightness and contrast refinement. Realistic cup surface gloss, condensation, and water droplets may be added only on the cup exterior or nearby surface, without changing the drink itself. Add beverage-type atmospheric effects only when naturally appropriate and only as external or surface-level styling. For food products, do not add ingredients, increase portion size, modify shape, regenerate toppings, or alter the food structure. Do not remove, hide, or omit existing toppings or garnishes. Allow only subtle color temperature refinement, surface gloss enhancement, background contrast adjustment, and minimal non-distracting surrounding prop styling. When no text or marketing copy is requested, place the product or anchored composition unit at the visual center of the canvas. When headline, product name, or marketing copy is requested, allow the product or anchored composition unit to shift naturally within the selected layout so that the product and text form a balanced advertising composition. Even when the product position changes for text composition, preserve the original product-support relationship and keep the product centered relative to its coaster, tray, plate, napkin, or supporting surface. Avoid unintended lateral drift, edge touching, floating appearance, detached support alignment, or support-product mismatch. Keep the entire product or anchored composition unit fully visible and prevent unnatural zoom-in, object cropping, isolated cutout appearance, and oversized rendering. Preserve balanced surrounding negative space and maintain stable composition across different aspect ratios. For all Instagram formats, keep the product or anchored composition unit around 50-55% of canvas height. Do not reduce product scale only because the layout is vertical. Maintain balanced safe margins while keeping the product visually dominant. Reserve visually appropriate empty space for future text composition when needed. If headline, product name, or marketing copy is requested, generate clean and readable Korean typography naturally integrated into the composition while preserving visual balance and product visibility. Apply intentional commercial lighting with a focused key light on the product to create an aspirational advertising mood without excessive studio effects. Use soft background separation with gradual depth transition to visually isolate the product and enhance its prominence without altering the original scene structure. Use realistic lighting, realistic colors, clean composition, minimal editing, modern Korean SNS visual aesthetic, and natural atmosphere. Do not generate people, hands, faces, characters, watermarks, UI elements, pricing UI, numeric offer labels, discount badge graphics, promotional offer visuals, storefront pricing boards, excessive props, cluttered backgrounds, distracting objects, random letters, or unrelated visual elements. Generate only the final composed promotional image.

details.label: 할인/이벤트 이미지
details.prompt_hint: Create an event-ready promotional image optimized for Danggeun posts and Korean neighborhood commerce aesthetics. Treat this as a complete promotional banner rather than a product catalog image. Keep the uploaded product as the dominant hero subject while preserving identity, ingredients, texture, and realistic appearance. Reduce product occupancy to approximately 45–60% of the canvas to reserve limited space for promotional storytelling and layered annotations while maintaining clean composition, breathable spacing, and strong product readability. Compose the layout similar to modern Korean lifestyle promotion posts and editorial memo aesthetics with a large expressive handwritten Korean headline, minimal supporting copy, visible event benefit emphasis, and strong visual hierarchy. Allocate visual attention approximately as headline 35–45%, product 45–55%, and CTA with promotion area 15–20%. Prioritize headline → product → event benefit → CTA. Render handwritten Korean typography naturally with visible stroke variation, slight irregularity, and human hand-drawn energy. Select headline colors adaptively based on readability, product colors, freshness mood, generated background, and overall composition. Allow natural multi-color emphasis inside the headline using up to 2–3 harmonized colors only when it improves freshness and visual hierarchy. Never force fixed headline colors. Avoid flat single-color headline rendering when a richer handwritten hierarchy improves the composition. Allow selective emphasis using underline, brush accents, marker strokes, handwritten highlight lines, and subtle adaptive color variation. Underlines, highlight strokes, doodles, and decorative emphasis marks must feel hand-drawn with uneven thickness, rough edges, slightly broken endings, and marker or brush texture rather than graphic lines or vector decoration. Apply the same adaptive color behavior so decorative accents harmonize naturally with the headline colors, product palette, and generated background. Allow one compact handwritten supporting information block with a maximum of three short lines positioned near the product. Group event benefits and CTA into a visually connected sticker-like information area rather than isolated text blocks. Place CTA prominently near the lower area using a simple clean handwritten sticker, paper note, taped memo, or lightweight label style with soft edges and minimal decoration. Avoid thick borders, oversized badges, strong shadows, heavy stickers, or bulky button appearance. Apply Danggeun brand orange (#F7863B) ONLY to CTA backgrounds and do not apply it to headlines, body text, decorations, props, lighting, background tint, or overall color grading. Keep CTA visually strongest while maintaining a lightweight and refined appearance. Allow memo-style annotations, speech bubbles, subtle doodles, arrows, highlight strokes, dotted guide lines, and casual decorative marks around the product but keep them understated and visually secondary. Add only small and subtle icons such as sparkles, hearts, and simple emphasis marks. Use thin white pen-like hand-drawn lines with rough and slightly uneven strokes to create natural visual flow and guide attention across the composition. When the product is a cold beverage, optionally add one subtle cooling cue such as a handwritten ICE stamp, freshness sticker, or seasonal cooling mark using a cool blue tone selected adaptively to harmonize with the product colors, freshness mood, lighting, and generated background while remaining visually lighter than the CTA. Keep cooling marks airy and handwritten rather than graphic. When identifiable fruit ingredients exist, allow up to two small ingredient-related supporting props only as secondary decoration while preserving the uploaded product as the sole hero subject and keeping all supporting props visually subordinate. Never generate unrelated ingredients, flavors, toppings, or decorative food props. Remove straws from the final generated image even if they exist in the uploaded image unless explicitly requested. Create more breathable spacing around the product. Use soft daylight, airy highlights, subtle background blur, brighter local contrast, and natural freshness to create a bright, airy, refreshing, and approachable atmosphere inspired by Korean lifestyle promotions rather than polished commercial campaigns. Emphasize daily value, limited offers, seasonal events, and local discovery feeling. Avoid excessive empty space, corporate layouts, luxury branding, minimal catalog composition, strong graphic effects, heavy doodles, cluttered sticker usage, overly dense text placement, excessive decorative props, or weak text hierarchy.
